rdf:Description.dc:title: "The Grand Review" - Abraham Lincoln's Second Inaugural Parade
rdf:Description.dc:description: After weeks of wet weather, thousands of spectators and participants trudged through the mud along Pennsylvania Avenue for President Abraham Lincoln's second Inauguration. This inaugural parade was the first to include African Americans as participants, not just spectators.
rdf:Description.dc:source: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division. View original.
